experiment.name: phase1_memory_replication
description: Replicates phase1_memory_traffic to get honest error bars.
Two reasons the single-run numbers cannot be quoted. First, an identical
avx2_mul configuration gave +0.0025 W (p=0.95) in one run and -0.106 W
(p=0.032) in the next, so between-run variability exceeds the within-run
CIs. Second, phase1_memory_traffic ran its victims in a fixed order and
mul_load_store was last -- interleaving cancels drift within a run, but
comparing effects across runs was still confounded with position in the
session, on a progressively warmer die.
Three repeats, victim order reshuffled each repeat, a different block
seed per repeat. Analyse with analysis.aggregate, which puts the
between-run spread next to the within-run CI.
